newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says no plans to build car plant in France.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says no plans to build car plant in France.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday that it does not currently have a plan to build a car plant in France and is still studying many possible options for its European investment.

Asked about a report on Monday in Britain's Financial Times that Japan's largest car maker plans to build a $1.6 billion car plant in Lens in northern France, a company spokeswoman said: "We have no such plans."
"We are still studying future investment in Europe and nothing has been decided," she added.

Toyota Motor president Hiroshi Okuda stirred up a row among Britain's Conservatives last month by seeming to rule out building new factories in the country if it stayed out of Europe's single currency.
The company spokeswoman said that Toyota plans to boost European sales to 600,000 by 2000 from 420,000 cars in calender 1996.
